{{Sailing at the 2020 Summer Olympics}}

The [[Laser (dinghy)|Laser]] competition at the [[2020 Summer Olympics]] was the men's one-person dinghy event and was held in [[Enoshima]], Japan, from 25 July to 1 August 2021.<ref name=olympedia-sal>{{cite web | url=https://www.olympedia.org/editions/61/sports/SAL | title=Olympedia – Sailing at the 2020 Summer Olympics }}</ref> 35 sailors from 35 nations competed in 11 races, including one medal-race where points were doubled.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/19008725 | title=Olympedia – One Person Dinghy (Laser), Men }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Sailing - Men's One Person Dinghy - Laser Schedule |url=https://olympics.com/tokyo-2020/olympic-games/en/results/sailing/event-schedule-laser-men.htm |work=[[Tokyo 2020 Olympics]] |access-date=28 July 2021 |archive-date=28 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210728214913/https://olympics.com/tokyo-2020/olympic-games/en/results/sailing/event-schedule-laser-men.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> The land venue was [[Enoshima Yacht Harbour]] and races were held on [[Sagami Bay]].<ref name=olympedia-sal/>

Medals were presented by IOC Member for Cuba Mrs [[María Caridad Colón]] and [[World Sailing]] chief executive officer David Graham.
